summary: Grayscale Sui Staking ETF filed an 8-K announcing a proposed amendment to its trust agreement to commence regular distributions of net cash proceeds from staking rewards to shareholders, aligning with IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-31 for grantor trust classification. The sponsor deems the amendment not materially adverse and provides 20 days' notice. No financial terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are disclosed. This is an operational/tax compliance update, not a special situation.
